title: Process Scheduling Report
description: Compare round robin against shortest job first on the three workloads in the handout. Include your timing table and say which one you would ship and why.

title: Deadlock Simulation
description: Build a small simulator that reproduces the dining philosophers deadlock, then break it two different ways. One submission per group.

title: Memory Management Case Study
description: Pick a real system and explain how it allocates and reclaims memory. Your group leader submits one document for the whole team.

title: Schema Design Proposal
description: Two pages on the system you plan to model, with a first pass at the schema. Normalisation is not marked yet, but your choice of keys is.

title: Query Optimisation Exercise
description: Take the five slow queries in the shared folder, read their plans, and rewrite each one. Show the plan before and after.

title: Responsive Layout Exercise
description: Rebuild the supplied desktop page so it works from 320px up. Mobile first, and no horizontal scrolling at any width.
